rule: Qualifying laws as screened in scripts/data/state/bills/universe.json (not re-screened); House floor votes of Lopez read from the same official roll call. A member is "not seated" on dates outside their House tenure.

bills.title: Pet Insurance and Wellness Programs

benefits.quote: may positively impact the private sector ... lower production costs for pet insurance providers

bills.screen: The bill may positively impact the private sector if the regulatory efficiency it establishes results in lower production costs for pet insurance providers.

bills.title: Electronic Delivery of Notices Between Landlords and Tenants

benefits.quote: may have an indeterminate positive fiscal impact on landlords and tenants

bills.screen: The bill may have an indeterminate positive fiscal impact on landlords and tenants (savings if email notices replace mail or certified mail).

bills.title: Pawnbroker Transaction Forms

benefits.quote: may have a positive fiscal impact on pawnbrokers by allowing them to use digital

bills.screen: The bill may have a positive fiscal impact on pawnbrokers by allowing them to use digital pawnbroker transaction forms.
bills.note: read AEG analysis 3/26/2025; final RC (4/1/2025) failed to fetch 3x

bills.title: Vessels

benefits.quote: indeterminate cost savings to a Clean Marine Manufacturer under the Clean Marina Program

bills.screen: There will be indeterminate cost savings to a Clean Marine Manufacturer under the Clean Marina Program (reduced sovereignty submerged land lease costs and waiver of extended-term lease surcharge).

bills.title: Motor Vehicle Manufacturers and Franchised Motor Vehicle Dealers

benefits.quote: may have a positive economic impact on franchised motor vehicle dealers in the state

bills.screen: The bill may have a positive economic impact on franchised motor vehicle dealers in the state.

bills.title: Roofing Services

benefits.quote: may have a positive economic impact on the private sector by increasing the number of licensed

bills.screen: The bill may have a positive economic impact on the private sector by increasing the number of licensed contractors who may evaluate and enhance certain roof-to-wall connections.

bills.title: Water Access Facilities

benefits.quote: indeterminate insignificant positive fiscal impact on marine manufacturers

bills.screen: The bill may have an indeterminate insignificant positive fiscal impact on marine manufacturers that participate in the Clean Marina Program (submerged land lease fee discount).

bills.title: Insurance Overpayment Claims Submitted to Psychologists

benefits.quote: may result in a positive fiscal impact for licensed psychologists

bills.screen: This may result in a positive fiscal impact for licensed psychologists or less fiscal uncertainty beyond the 12-month period [insurer overpayment claim look-back limited].
bills.note: read HP analysis 3/19/2025; final RC (3/26/2025) failed to fetch

bills.title: Prearranged Transportation Services

benefits.category: ride-hailing companies (transportation network companies) and paratransit providers
benefits.quote: may have an indeterminate positive impact on the private sector by exempting TNCs

bills.screen: The bill may have an indeterminate positive impact on the private sector by exempting TNCs from specified requirements (bus transit safety inspections, driver training) and enabling alternative paratransit providers to receive specified funds.

bills.title: Corrections

benefits.quote: may have an indeterminate positive fiscal impact on contractor-operated correctional facilities

bills.screen: PRIVATE SECTOR: The bill may have an indeterminate positive fiscal impact on contractor-operated correctional facilities (DOC retains control over and pays for certain dental, medical, psychological and dietary services at those facilities).

bills.title: Restrictions on Firearms and Ammunition During Emergencies

benefits.quote: the bill may have an indeterminate positive impact on such businesses

bills.screen: PRIVATE SECTOR: The bill repeals a prohibition against selling firearms or ammunition during a local state of emergency arising from a threat of violence or public disorder. To the extent... private businesses are able to sell firearms and ammunition..., the bill may have an indeterminate positive impact on such businesses.

bills.title: Property Rights

benefits.quote: may reduce costs that the private sector would otherwise incur to remove squatters from commercial properties

bills.screen: The bill may reduce costs that the private sector would otherwise incur to remove squatters from commercial properties.

bills.title: Fire Prevention

benefits.quote: may have a positive fiscal impact on contractors who use the simplified permitting process

bills.screen: The bill may have a positive fiscal impact on contractors who use the simplified permitting process by allowing them to begin work on fire alarm and fire sprinkler projects immediately upon submitting a completed application.

bills.title: Brownfields

benefits.category: brownfield cleanup and redevelopment applicants (Voluntary Cleanup Tax Credit)
benefits.quote: indeterminate positive fiscal impact on the private sector associated with the expanded eligibility of the VCTC

bills.screen: PRIVATE SECTOR: The bill may have an indeterminate positive fiscal impact on the private sector associated with the expanded eligibility of the VCTC (Voluntary Cleanup Tax Credit).
bills.note: business type inferred: tax credit goes to parties cleaning up contaminated sites; analysis says only 'private sector'

bills.title: Utility Relocation

benefits.quote: reduces or eliminates utility relocation costs for communications services providers (e.g., broadband Internet, cable, video, and voice service providers)

bills.screen: Private sector: the bill reduces or eliminates utility relocation costs for communications services providers (e.g., broadband Internet, cable, video, and voice service providers); costs shift to FDOT, expressway authorities, counties, municipalities.

bills.title: Services for Individuals with Developmental Disabilities

benefits.quote: pilot enrollee capitation

bills.screen: No private sector subsection; state government section funds IDD Pilot capitation payments to the pilot managed care plan (~$69.6M plus ~$31.2M for waitlist enrollees), an evaluation contract, and an iBudget algorithm study.
bills.note: final z analysis (h1103z.HSS) failed to fetch twice; used HHS (latest fetched)

bills.title: Behavioral Health Managing Entities

benefits.category: behavioral health managing entities (DCF contractors); IT/audit vendors
benefits.quote: These costs would be covered by the funds DCF pays them under their contracts.

bills.screen: MEs may experience an indeterminate fiscal impact to upgrade systems and processes to collect and report required data and information. These costs would be covered by the funds DCF pays them under their contracts.
bills.note: bill also has $1M grants for ME system modernization and DCF audit/vendor contracts; MEs are mostly nonprofits, borderline

bills.title: Construction Regulations

benefits.category: building contractors, private plan reviewers/inspectors, alarm contractors, spaceport operators (regulatory relief)
benefits.quote: may lead to a decrease in construction time

bills.screen: The bill's requirement that local governments process change orders within 30 days may lead to a decrease in construction time. The prohibition on local governments from requiring contracts as a condition to apply for a building permit may have a positive impact by protecting certain proprietary information.

bills.title: Expedited DNA Testing Grant Program

benefits.quote: may require outsourcing to a private entity

bills.screen: The bill may have an indeterminate positive impact on the private sector to the extent that the bill authorizes recipients of grant funds to cover expenses related to using certain DNA testing, which may require outsourcing to a private entity. Subject to appropriation.
bills.note: z1 fetch failed; used JDC (bill passed unamended after JDC)

bills.title: Veterans' Benefits Assistance

benefits.category: veterans' benefits consultants (paid market legalized, capped); fingerprinting (Livescan) providers
benefits.quote: indeterminate positive fiscal impact on any Livescan Service Provider due to additional fees

bills.screen: May have an indeterminate negative fiscal impact on a person seeking compensation for advising veterans on benefits who must submit to background screening ($36.71). There may be an indeterminate positive fiscal impact on any Livescan Service Provider due to additional fees.

bills.title: Aerospace Industry

benefits.category: Florida aerospace companies (International Aerospace Innovation Fund)
benefits.quote: may have a positive impact on funding for Florida aerospace companies or organizations

bills.screen: Funding for the IAIF may be derived from private sector investments and international contributions, as secured by Space Florida. Indeterminate. However, the bill may have a positive impact on funding for Florida aerospace companies or organizations, since a project must involve at least one Florida-based aerospace company.

bills.title: Transportation

benefits.category: FDOT road contractors (surety bond waiver); also seaport shipbuilders/manufacturers eligible for seaport funds
benefits.quote: FDOT's contractors may experience a reduction in surety bond costs

bills.screen: Motor vehicle owners who currently have an HOV decal would be subject to the payment of tolls (section 5). FDOT's contractors may experience a reduction in surety bond costs due to the authorization of the Secretary of Transportation to waive certain surety bond requirements (section 26).

bills.title: Warranty Associations

benefits.category: service warranty companies (large, non-publicly traded; regulatory relief)
benefits.quote: option for a non-publicly traded service warranty association to forego securing contractual liability insurance

bills.screen: The bill provides an option for a non-publicly traded service warranty association to forego securing contractual liability insurance, establishing unearned premium reserves, and complying with premium writing ratios if it or its parent has a net worth of at least $100 million and provides audited statements.

bills.title: Platting

benefits.category: real estate developers (faster administrative plat approval)
benefits.quote: may reduce carrying costs for those relying on a local government to process applications

bills.screen: The bill may reduce carrying costs for those relying on a local government to process applications relating to real property development before a parcel can be sold.

bills.title: Health Facilities

benefits.category: private health care facilities (financing via health facilities authorities)
benefits.quote: The bill expands the available options for authorities to assist private entities in acquiring, constructing, financing, and refinancing projects supporting the provision of health care services.

bills.screen: Expands the options health facilities authorities have to help private entities acquire, build, finance and refinance projects that provide health care services.

bills.title: Child Care and Early Learning Providers

benefits.category: private preschools / licensed child care facilities (exempt from local special assessments)
benefits.quote: reduces the ability of local governments to levy special assessments on preschools

bills.screen: Indeterminate, likely significant recurring negative impact on local government, because the bill limits local special assessments on preschools (licensed child care facilities). The REC estimates a $5.9M local revenue reduction in FY 2025-26.
bills.note: Borderline: the private-sector section names preschools as the businesses no longer assessed but frames it as a local-government cost and gives no savings figure. Review.

bills.title: Certified Recovery Residences

benefits.quote: The overall effect of the bill may be to simplify the establishment and maintenance of a recovery residence, providing an indeterminate positive impact.

bills.screen: May make recovery residences simpler to establish and maintain, an indeterminate positive impact.

bills.title: Emergencies

benefits.category: farmers (agricultural producers) - property tax relief on storm-idled equipment
benefits.quote: Agricultural producers with agricultural equipment unable to be used due to hurricanes will experience property tax relief.

bills.screen: Agricultural producers with agricultural equipment unable to be used due to hurricanes will experience property tax relief. Residents and businesses affected by disasters may experience quicker post-storm permit processing times and reduced or waived permit and inspection fees.

bills.title: Implementing the 2025-2026 General Appropriations Act

benefits.category: lottery retailers (6% commission); Hurricane Michael-affected businesses (loans); drug-pricing vendor contract
benefits.quote: require the commission for lottery ticket sales to be set at 6 percent

bills.screen: Conference report has no private-sector section (Senate AP analysis: None). Body: sets lottery retailer commission at 6% (s.68); Rebuild Florida loans to Hurricane Michael-hit businesses (s.97); AHCA to procure drug-price negotiation vendor paid from savings (s.39).

bills.title: Prekindergarten Through Grade 12 Education

benefits.category: charter school operators (Schools of Hope, nonprofit)
benefits.quote: The bill authorizes a school of hope to co-locate with another public school in any facility.

bills.screen: House final analysis has no private-sector section (state government only). Body: Schools of Hope expanded - universities/colleges may sponsor, hope schools may co-locate with any public school facility, performance funds usable for any operations; names 7 hope operators.

bills.title: Health and Human Services

benefits.category: elder-care PACE providers (market entry); accredited cancer centers (research funding)
benefits.quote: PACE provider to operate in a geographic service area which has an existing provider

bills.screen: Conference report has no private-sector section. Body: lets a PACE provider operate in a service area with an existing provider if need found; authorizes Casey DeSantis program funding for accredited cancer centers; Medicaid premium assistance for employer coverage.

bills.title: Taxation

benefits.category: commercial tenants/landlords, data centers, airlines, cardrooms, racetracks, retailers (tax breaks)
benefits.quote: The bill repeals the 2.0% business rent tax effective October 1, 2025

bills.screen: No private-sector section (state/local revenue only). Tax package: repeals 2% business rent tax; data center exemption; aviation fuel tax repeal; cardroom tax 10%->8%; $1M Tampa Bay Downs, $4M Gulfstream Park; NASCAR championship admissions exemption; citrus packinghouse assessment relief.

bills.title: City of Oviedo, Seminole County

benefits.category: bars and restaurants (alcohol licensees) in Oviedo entertainment district
benefits.quote: The bill may have an indeterminant positive fiscal impact on local revenues

bills.screen: No private-sector section. Local govt: may have an indeterminant positive fiscal impact on local revenues (sales tax, licensing). Bill requires DABT to issue special licenses so licensees in Oviedo entertainment district can sell drinks for carry-out within the district.

bills.title: Duval County

named: event centers in the City of Jacksonville's Urban Transition Area
benefits.quote: a special alcoholic beverage license to event centers in the City of Jacksonville's Urban Transition Area

bills.screen: no private sector section; analysis text: special alcoholic beverage license for event centers (1,100-1,400 occupancy, ticketed) in Jacksonville Urban Transition Area; local revenue positive
bills.note: b:true from analysis text (no private-sector section)

bills.title: Special Beverage Licenses for Equestrian Sport Facilities in Marion County

named: equestrian sport facilities in Marion County
benefits.quote: to issue a special alcoholic beverage license to equestrian sport facilities in Marion County that meet certain conditions.

bills.screen: no private sector section; analysis text: special alcoholic beverage license for Marion County equestrian sport facilities (>=500 acres, 2+ lodging, 3+ food service); +$15M/$30M state & local revenue
bills.note: b:true from analysis text (no private-sector section)
